steps.input:
source = '''def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(range(10), key=lambda color: sum(cell == color for row in grid for cell in row))
    divider_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(cell == 2 for cell in row)), None)
    divider_col = next((c for c in range(width) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(height))), None)

    if divider_row is not None:
        obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(height) for c in range(width)
               if r != divider_row and grid[r][c] not in (background, 2)]
        if not obj:
            return grid
        lo, hi = min(r for r, _, _ in obj), max(r for r, _, _ in obj)
        if (lo + hi) / 2 > divider_row:
            direction = -1
            gap = lo - divider_row - 1
            marker = hi if gap > 0 else hi + 1
        else:
            direction = 1
            gap = divider_row - hi - 1
            marker = lo if gap > 0 else lo - 1
        if gap > 0:
            for r, c, _ in obj:
                grid[r][c] = background
            for r, c, color in obj:
                grid[r + direction][c] = color
        if 0 <= marker < height:
            grid[marker] = [8] * width
    elif divider_col is not None:
        obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(height) for c in range(width)
               if c != divider_col and grid[r][c] not in (background, 2)]
        if not obj:
            return grid
        lo, hi = min(c for _, c, _ in obj), max(c for _, c, _ in obj)
        if (lo + hi) / 2 > divider_col:
            direction = -1
            gap = lo - divider_col - 1
            marker = hi if gap > 0 else hi + 1
        else:
            direction = 1
            gap = divider_col - hi - 1
            marker = lo if gap > 0 else lo - 1
        if gap > 0:
            for r, c, _ in obj:
                grid[r][c] = background
            for r, c, color in obj:
                grid[r][c + direction] = color
        if 0 <= marker < width:
            for r in range(height):
                grid[r][marker] = 8
    return grid
'''
